text.p: West Ham and ex-England striker Tony Cottee has agreed a transfer to Malaysian club Selangor for a fee believed to be in the region of 750,000 pounds ($1.19 million).
Cottee, who has signed a one-year contract with Selangor with an option for a further 12 months, will fly out to Malaysia for pre-season training before his new club's campaign resumes in January.

"I am leaving West Ham with a certain amount of sadness because, first and foremost, I'm a great fan of the club," he said on Thursday. "But the deal was right for all parties concerned, and you can't always say that with a transfer."
